surface: gh plate CLI, MCP server, plate_core subprocess
summary: Hide Windows consoles when PLATE runs gh or git, and make babysit --watch stoppable (#1073).
migration_impact: No repository migration. Windows agents that babysit a PR no longer flash focus-stealing console windows on each poll. A watcher started with --watch stops when its parent process exits, or with `gh plate pr babysit --stop`.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core and gh-plate to the release that contains this fix (targeted at 0.8.3).
2. Stop any watcher left from an older build: `gh plate pr babysit --stop`, or taskkill the leftover python.exe.
3. Start watches with `gh plate pr babysit <pr> --watch`. Stop them with `gh plate pr babysit --stop`.
agent_notes: On Windows, do not spawn gh or git with shell=True or a bare subprocess call. Use plate_core.procutil.run_hidden so CREATE_NO_WINDOW is set and text is decoded as UTF-8. Babysit --watch writes .agentic/babysit/babysit-<owner>-<repo>-<pr>.pid and exits when the parent process dies. Stop a leftover watcher with `gh plate pr babysit --stop` rather than leaving a detached poll loop running. Copilot CLI sessions hit the same gh/git console spawn.
